verdict.rationale: Docs confirm AI Gateway proxies requests to providers using the developer's own API key (e.g. 'Switch providers by changing the model and apiKey parameters' and passthrough pricing with no markup, meaning the developer's own provider account/key is billed directly), and it connects to native provider APIs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints for many providers. missing for 10: no explicit first-party doc section titled 'bring your own key' explaining storage/security of BYO keys, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact flow.
